content.short: Robinhood provides commission-free investing including stocks, options, ETF and cryptocurrency.
content.description: Robinhood, founded in 2013 by Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Bhatt, is a financial services company offering a platform for commission-free investing. It provides access to tools for trading stocks, options, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies to support varied investment strategies. Unlike many crypto exchanges, Robinhood does not charge a fee for buying and selling cryptocurrency, making it a straightforward option for investors seeking broad market access and cost-effective participation in both traditional and digital assets.

resources.title: What Is a Limit Order?
resources.tldr: An order to buy or sell at a set price or better, with the catch stated plainly: there is no guarantee it ever gets filled.

resources.title: What Is a Bond?
resources.tldr: An IOU issued by a company or government in exchange for cash, which then trades in its own secondary market at a price that moves.

resources.title: What Is an Expense Ratio?
resources.tldr: The administrative and management cost a fund charges, and why a number that looks small compounds into a large one over time.
